pages.text: Craft eight $(item)Pipes$() from two rows of iron ingots with a gap between them. Craft a $(item)Pipe Wrench$() from iron ingots too.

Pipes join each other automatically. A pipe also reaches any adjacent block that exposes an item, fluid or energy capability, but only once that face is set to $(thing)extract$().$(br2)Use the wrench on a face to cycle it: connected, disconnected, extract.
